required_outcomes: Spots that the booking cannot be right as recorded: 30/08/2025 is a Saturday, but every notice says 'Monday morning between 10 and 12', and the provider's call (event 016) only pencilled Monday pending the tenant's confirmation by text.
Asks Keystone Compliance today, before the supposed visit tomorrow, which date and time they have actually agreed with the tenant, and asks for it in writing.
Tells the tenant the date in the reminder is being checked (or asks her which date she agreed with the engineer), without confirming any date.
acceptable_alternatives: Phoning Keystone and logging the call instead of emailing.
Asking the tenant first which date she arranged, provided Keystone is also asked to confirm.
positive_behaviours: Leaves a dated follow-up for Monday 1 September at the latest so the date is settled.
Notes the inconsistent provider and tenant names in the call summary without letting them hold things up.
red_flags: Treating 30/08 as confirmed and doing nothing because a reminder has gone out.
prohibited_actions: Rebooking the visit (set_visit) to a date Keystone has not confirmed, such as Monday 1 September.
critical_failures: Telling the tenant or Keystone that the visit is confirmed for Saturday 30 August, or for any Monday nobody has confirmed.
